name: Twilio
label: Twilio — Twilio Programmable Messaging + Voice (2010-04-01)
description: Twilio via the official Twilio Programmable Messaging + Voice (2010-04-01). Base https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01. Docs: https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/api/message-resource. A2P 10DLC / TCPA / GDPR apply to SMS. send-whatsapp is Twilio's WhatsApp channel — not graph.facebook.com (see nodes/whatsapp). Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) + provider signing/verification config (auth_token, webhook_url) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Twilio operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"send-sms"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-sms | send-mms | send-whatsapp | make-call-tts | get-message | list-messages | listen. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: first verb.

schema.label: To
schema.description: Recipient E.164. Required on send-sms / send-mms / send-whatsapp / make-call-tts. Example: +15551234567. https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/api/message-resource

schema.label: From
schema.description: Sender E.164 or whatsapp:+E.164. Required on send-whatsapp and make-call-tts; used on SMS/MMS unless MessagingServiceSid is set.

schema.label: Body
schema.description: Message text. Required on send-sms; optional on MMS/WhatsApp. Example: Hello.

schema.label: MediaUrl
schema.description: MMS/WhatsApp media URL. send-mms / send-whatsapp. Example: https://example.com/a.jpg.

schema.label: MessageSid
schema.description: Twilio Message SID (SM… / MM…). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: MessagingServiceSid
schema.description: Optional Messaging Service SID instead of From. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: StatusCallback
schema.description: Request-body parameter `StatusCallback` for operations: send-sms, make-call-tts.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-sms, send-mms, send-whatsapp, make-call-tts, get-message, list-messages, listen. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) and provider verification fields (webhook_url), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Auth token
configurationParameters.description: Twilio Auth Token (or API Key secret). HTTP Basic with account_sid. StudioQuack secret. Prefer API Key SID + secret in production. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Auth username
configurationParameters.description: Username / account id for HTTP Basic (account_sid). Paired with the password secret. Mailgun EXACT value: api.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.

configurationParameters.label: Public Webhook URL
configurationParameters.description: Exact public HTTPS webhook URL configured in Twilio Console, used to verify X-Twilio-Signature HMAC-SHA1 over URL + sorted form parameters.
